summary: Build transparent financial scenarios with traceable assumptions and sensitivity analysis.
intents: what is the NPV and IRR of this project
model the loan repayments for this purchase
run best and worst case scenarios for the budget
is this investment worth it given these cash flows
prerequisites: the decision context and model horizon
provided inputs or clearly labeled assumptions
verify: Every assumption is listed with its source and can be changed in one place
A sensitivity table shows which inputs move the result most
Units, currency and period are stated for every figure
